profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apex Fintech Solutions
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with the ability to work independently and as a team member with excellent communication, organization and leadership skills. Energetic, dependable and hard working individual with a history of meeting goals successfully and managing multiple tasks simultaneously. 

Skilled in JavaScript, Application Frameworks, React.js, Application Development, and Web Development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Computer Science from Montana State University-Bozeman.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Code Girls United helps build confidence in our future generation by providing hands on experience in technology and business. 

Code Girls United is a free after school program for 4th-8th grade girls.  Each student learns the basics of creating and designing an app using App Inventor that solves a local community problem.  The students  compete in three different competitions, including Code Girls United own NW Regional App Challenge (scholarship prizes awarded), the International Technovation Challenge, and the nationwide Congressional App Challenge.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Northern Rockies Snow and Avalanche Workshop
volunteerExperiences.description: Northern Rockies Snow and Avalanche Workshop (NRSAW) is an annual workshop that unites professional and novice backcountry users from a wide range of sports and professions.
